proposed.text: Architect A prepared and sealed the architectural design documents as Architect-of-Record. Architect B supervised construction as Architect-in-Charge of Construction. During construction, the contractor used inferior concrete that was not detected during supervision, and the edifice later collapsed. Who is the source-backed liability focus for that construction defect?

options.text: Only Architect A, because every collapse is automatically a design-document defect
Only the contractor, because professional supervision never creates solidary liability
The contractor and Architect B may be solidarily liable if defective supervision contributed; Architect A is not liable unless the plans or specifications were defective
All parties are always equally liable regardless of the cause of collapse
